response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile web/full-stack and systems developer with broad language experience (D, JavaScript/TypeScript, C, C++, Java), but the role requires native-level Japanese, deep Linux kernel source modification experience, and hands-on embedded LAN-switch security work (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection, switch chip SDKs) — none of which are evidenced in his resume. His C experience is limited to an older IDE-component role rather than UNIX/Linux kernel work, and there is no Japanese language listed at all, which is a hard requirement.
strengths: Broad, deep software engineering experience across many languages and domains
Some low-level/systems programming exposure (C/C++, async I/O, embedded robotics work)
Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and work across full stack, hardware, and infra
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed, but native-level is a strict requirement
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation/modification experience
No security/networking domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, switch protocols, embedded firmware)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded LAN-switch security experience
Strong general software engineering and C/C++ background
